SELECT c.id AS id, c.group_id AS groupId, g.group_code AS groupCode, c.code AS code, c.code_nm AS codeNm, c.description AS description, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.status AS status, c.extra_value AS extraValue FROM basic_code c JOIN basic_code_group g ON c.group_id = g.id WHERE g.group_code = #{groupCode} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
